summary: Bulletin ID: 2026-121-AWS Scope: AWS Content Type: Important (requires attention) Publication Date: 10/01/2026 10:30 AM PDT Description: security-agent-mcp-server is an open-source Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, published by AWS in the awslabs/mcp repository, that AI assistants use to run local security scans (including differential "diff" scans) over source code. Impacted versions: >= 0.1.1 AND < 0.2.0 Please refer to the article below for the most up-to-date and complete information related to this AWS Security Bulletin.

The 1.6.1 release blocked internal-address reach for this code path but did not fully
title: CVE-2026-103956, CVE-2026-103957, and CVE-2026-103958 - Issues in Loom for AWS

summary: Bulletin ID: 2026-125-AWS Scope: AWS Content Type: Important (requires attention) Publication Date: 10/02/2026 13:00 PM PDT Description: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio is an AWS service that unifies data, analytics, and AI development. It lets you find and access your organization's data and act on it with integrated, purpose-built tools. We identified CVE-2026-104019, an issue with the startup of SageMaker Spaces in SageMaker Unified Studio. The startup script in a SageMaker Space performs a network validation against all the available SageMaker connections in a project. Under certain conditions, improper sanitization of connection details during this validation could allow arbitrary code to be executed in the Space of another project member. In projects with the Trusted Identity Propagation feature enabled, this issue could result in a user with project contributor permissions (or higher) gaining access to another member's temporary execution role credentials and calling downstream trusted identity propagation-enabled AWS services on their behalf. We implemented a fix to all supported SageMaker Distribution versions to sanitize connection details during the startup validation process. The fix is deployed globally and will apply to all Spaces automatically on the next startup. Impacted versions: - 2.8.x - 2.13.x: all versions affected, no fix (end of support) - 2.14.x: < 2.14.12, fixed in 2.14.12 - 3.3.x - 3.8.x: all versions affected, no fix (end of support) - 3.9.x: < 3.9
title: CVE-2026-104019 - OS command injection in the Studio Space startup script in Amazon SageMaker Distribution

title: CVE-2026-105812 and CVE-2026-106032: Issue with Bedrock AgentCore Starter Toolkit - Import Agent Code Injection and SSRF

summary: Bulletin ID: 2026-126-AWS Scope: AWS Content Type: Important (requires attention) Publication Date: 10/06/2026 13:00 PM PDT Description: QnABot on AWS is a sample solution of a multi-channel, multi-language conversational interface (chatbot) that responds to your customer's questions, answers, and feedback. We identified CVE-2026-105811 in the optional Amazon Q Business Lambda hook sample of QnABot on AWS. The Amazon Q Business Lambda hook sample (q-business-lambda-hook) is an optional integration sample included in the QnABot on AWS repository. It requires separate, manual deployment and additional setup; it is not deployed automatically with QnABot. Customers who have not deployed this sample are not affected and do not need to take action. Authorization bypass through a user-controlled key in the sample included with QnABot on AWS versions 7.0.0 through 7.4.5 might allow an authenticated remote user to read arbitrary Amazon S3 objects in the deploying AWS account. To remediate this issue, affected customers should update the QnABot on AWS stack to version 7.4.6 or later and then redeploy the Amazon Q Business Lambda hook sample stack. Updating the QnABot on AWS stack alone does not deliver the fix. Impacted versions: >=7.0.0, <7.4.6 Please refer to the article below for the most up-to-date and complete information related to this AWS Security Bulletin.
title: CVE-2026-105811 - Authorization bypass through a user-controlled key in the Amazon Q Business Lambda hook sample in QnABot on AWS

summary: Bulletin ID: 2026-129-AWS Scope: AWS Content Type: Important (requires attention) Publication Date: 10/08/2026 10:30 PM PDT Description: AWS Toolkit for Visual Studio Code is an open source extension that lets developers work with AWS services, including Amazon CodeCatalyst, from within Visual Studio Code. summary: Bulletin ID: 2026-130-AWS Scope: AWS Content Type: Important (requires attention) Publication Date: 10/08/2026 11:30 AM PDT Description: Amazon Agent Plugins for AWS is an open source collection of plugins that extends supported AI coding agents with AWS-focused workflows and tool integrations. The databases-on-aws plugin provides database design, development, migration, and operational guidance, including Aurora DSQL helper scripts. We identified CVE-2026-107322, where an incomplete list of disallowed inputs in databases-on-aws versions before 1.7.1 could allow a remote unauthenticated actor to supply crafted content that an agent ingests. The affected code is not a listening network service; operating-system command execution on the host is possible only if the agent subsequently invokes the local helper with the crafted database command value. Any resulting command runs with the permissions of the process running the helper. This issue does not affect the Aurora DSQL service or bypass database privileges. summary: Bulletin ID: 2026-135-AWS Scope: AWS Content Type: Important (requires attention) Publication Date: 10/14/2026 12:30 PM PDT Description: We identified CVE-2026-110310, an issue in Amazon S3 encryption client for .NET that could allow a remote user who can read encrypted objects in the S3 bucket can force a padding downgrade by altering the padding scheme recorded in an object's metadata to legacy PKCS#1 v1.5. summary: Bulletin ID: 2026-139-AWS Scope: AWS Content Type: Important (requires attention) Publication Date: 10/16/2026 10:15 AM PDT Description: FreeRTOS-Plus-TCP is an open-source, thread-safe TCP/IP stack for the FreeRTOS kernel, distributed by Amazon for use on embedded and IoT devices. AWS identified two issues with FreeRTOS-Plus-TCP, affecting multiple versions. CVE-2026-102551: improper verification of the source of a communication channel in the IPv6 Router Advertisement handler. The handler does not fully validate that a received Router Advertisement originates from an on-link source before acting on it. Under certain conditions, a remote third-party might influence an endpoint's IPv6 gateway, prefix, and address configuration, potentially enabling interception of the device's IPv6 traffic. This issue is reachable in the library's default configuration, where ipconfigUSE_IPv6 and ipconfigUSE_RA are both enabled. CVE-2026-102552: improper verification of the source of a communication channel in the DNS resolver. The resolver does not fully validate that a DNS reply originates from the server that was queried before accepting it. Under certain conditions, a remote third-party might insert a chosen address into the device's DNS cache, potentially redirecting the device's subsequent connections for the affected name. Impacted versions: - CVE-2026-102551 (Router Advertisement): <= V4.4.1 - CVE-2026-102552 (DNS resolver): <= V4.4.1 Please refer to the article below for the most up-
title: CVE-2026-102551 & CVE-2026-102552 - Issue with FreeRTOS-Plus-TCP

summary: Bulletin ID: 2026-138-AWS Scope: AWS Content Type: Important (requires attention) Publication Date: 10/16/2026 10:00 AM PDT Description: FreeRTOS-Kernel is a real-time operating system kernel for microcontrollers and small microprocessors, distributed by Amazon. AWS identified two issues with the FreeRTOS-Kernel Arm Cortex-R82 (Armv8-R AArch64) MPU port, affecting multiple versions. CVE-2026-109587: incorrect authorization in the Arm Cortex-R82 MPU port. On MPU-enabled builds, the port does not correctly enforce the memory-region boundaries assigned to an unprivileged task when it passes a buffer argument to an MPU system call. Under certain conditions, an unprivileged task might read and write privileged kernel memory outside the regions assigned to it. This issue affects Arm Cortex-R82 builds with configENABLE_MPU=1; applications that do not use the FreeRTOS MPU are not affected. CVE-2026-109588: numeric truncation in the MPU buffer authorization check on the Arm Cortex-R82 MPU port. On MPU-enabled builds, the buffer-length validation does not correctly account for the full length of a buffer passed to a stream buffer system call. Under certain conditions, an unprivileged task might read or write privileged kernel memory beyond the validated buffer window. This issue affects Arm Cortex-R82 builds with configENABLE_MPU=1; applications that do not use the FreeRTOS MPU are not affected. Impacted versions: - CVE-2026-109587 (MPU region authorization): V11.3.0 and V11.3.1 (Arm C
title: CVE-2026-109587 & CVE-2026-109588 - Issue with FreeRTOS-Kernel

summary: Bulletin ID: 2026-140-AWS Scope: AWS Content Type: Important (requires attention) Publication Date: 10/20/2026 13:00 PM PDT Description: Kiro Crew is an open-source personal AI agent that can be reached from a web dashboard, a CLI, or messaging channels such as WhatsApp, and that runs tools on the operator's machine. We identified CVE-2026-112380, an authorization issue in the WhatsApp channel and the internal subagent run-control endpoints. In certain configurations where a WhatsApp group was added to an operator's allowed groups, or where the direct-message policy was set to open, a member of that WhatsApp group could send instructions to another session's subagent. The subagent then executed those instructions on the operator's machine under that session's approval policy, and the resulting audit trail was attributed to the operator rather than the actual sender. The default configuration is not affected: whatsapp.groups defaults to empty and whatsapp.dm_policy defaults to self, so a group that is not explicitly listed is dropped before dispatch. Impacted versions: >=0.4.0 AND <0.7.2 Please refer to the article below for the most up-to-date and complete information related to this AWS Security Bulletin. Read the article
title: CVE-2026-112380 - Missing authorization in the WhatsApp channel in Kiro Crew

A crafted prompt, delivered through content the agent is asked to process, could instruct the model to call the tool with masking turned off. The tool would then return the agent host's environment variables in cleartext, including cloud credentials and API keys, without prompting the operator for consent. Impacted versions: >= 0.1.0 AND < 0.8.6 Please refer to the article below for the most up-to-date and complete information related to this AWS Security Bulletin. Read this article

summary: Bulletin ID: 2026-157-AWS Publication Date: 10/30/2026 09:00 AM PDT Description: We identified CVE-2026-119116, a use-after-free in the SetClient command handler of the kmstool-enclave example application, where an application that executes on the parent EC2 instance could send crafted messages over vsock to corrupt heap memory inside the enclave and execute arbitrary code within it. Only enclave images that include kmstool-enclave, or code derived from it, are affected. We also identified CVE-2026-119148, an input validation issue in the SDK library where the AWS KMS server name is built from a caller-supplied region string. A third party could supply a crafted region to impersonate KMS to the enclave and inject forged responses, such as actor-chosen key material. Impacted versions: aws-nitro-enclaves-sdk-c <= v0.4.5 (CVE-2026-119116 affects kmstool-enclave only; CVE-2026-119148 affects the library) Please refer to the article below for the most up-to-date and complete information related to this AWS Security Bulletin. summary: Bulletin ID: 2026-158-AWS Publication Date: 10/30/2026 10:30 AM PDT Description: FreeRTOS-Kernel is a real-time operating system kernel for microcontrollers and small microprocessors, distributed by Amazon. We identified CVE-2026-119086, the queue-set selection path does not fully validate that the referenced kernel object is a queue set before operating on it. On MPU-enabled builds with queue sets enabled, an unprivileged task can cause the kernel to write beyond the intended destination while executing in a privileged context, which affects the integrity of privileged execution. Applications that are built without queue sets are not affected. Impacted versions: >=V7.4.0 AND <=V11.3.2 (MPU-enabled ports with configUSE_QUEUE_SETS=1) Please refer to the article below for the most up-to-date and complete information related to this AWS Security Bulletin. Read this article
